references.text: Continuation of the list of cities assigned to the tribe of Benjamin, showing the geographical connection between the towns in this area.
The Avvites (העוים) are also mentioned here as a people who lived in the region, referring to the same ethnic group.
Reference to the Avvites who lived in villages near Gaza, providing historical background for this people.
Ephrath is mentioned in connection with Rachel, who died near Ephrath (Bethlehem), and Ophrah may be related to this area in Benjamin.
Ophrah is mentioned as a town in the territory of Benjamin where the Philistines plundered, confirming the city's geographical location.
